name: Shaman
resourceDesc: Breath, a lungful of a hundred, pays for every calling; it returns with every stone you stand by.
identity: A weather-speaker of the high moors who calls on rain, stone and the old dead; standing stones raised from the ground, not built. GAME-ONLY (no shamans in canon).

branches.name: Rainspeaker
branches.loop: Call the rain on the party, Tide Mend the one under, Chain Mend when three are low.
branches.tradeoff: The rain falls where you stood: move and it does not follow.

nodes.name: Soft Rain
nodes.desc: Rain Call heals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Long Rain
nodes.desc: Rain Call lasts 2s longer per rank.

nodes.name: High Tide
nodes.desc: Tide Mend heals 5% more per rank.

nodes.name: Running Water
nodes.desc: Chain Mend leaps once more per rank.

nodes.name: Spring Stone
nodes.desc: A stone that gives the party 1% health a second per rank.

nodes.name: The Flood
nodes.desc: Once a fight, Rain Call heals triple for 4s.

branches.name: Stormcaller
branches.loop: Squall to build the Thunderhead, loose it, and drop Hailfall on the pack.
branches.tradeoff: The Thunderhead held too long breaks on you.

nodes.name: Hard Squall
nodes.desc: Squall deals 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Gathering Cloud
nodes.desc: Thunderhead charges 10% faster per rank.

nodes.name: Heavy Hail
nodes.desc: Hailfall's circle is 0.5 m wider per rank.

nodes.name: Wind at the Back
nodes.desc: Squall casts 0.15s faster per rank.

nodes.name: Storm Stone
nodes.desc: A stone that strikes the nearest foe every 2s.

nodes.name: The Tempest
nodes.desc: A loosed Thunderhead also hits two more foes.

branches.name: Stonebound
branches.loop: Earthskin on, Rooting Stamp to hold the pack, Cairn when the blow comes.
branches.tradeoff: Rooted, you do not move either.

nodes.name: Thick Earthskin
nodes.desc: Earthskin cuts 2% more damage per rank.

nodes.name: Heavy Stamp
nodes.desc: Rooting Stamp holds 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: High Cairn
nodes.desc: Cairn absorbs 6% more per rank.

nodes.name: Grip of Stone
nodes.desc: Taunted foes are slowed 5% per rank.

nodes.name: Standing Stone
nodes.desc: A stone that draws the pack's notice to it for 4s.

nodes.name: The Mountain
nodes.desc: Once a fight, take no damage for 3s.

branches.name: Gravewind
branches.loop: Moor Wind to push, Mist to blind, Barrow-call to send them running.

nodes.name: Strong Wind
nodes.desc: Moor Wind pushes 0.5 m further per rank.

nodes.name: Thick Mist
nodes.desc: Mist blinds 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Old Barrow
nodes.desc: Barrow-call fears 1s longer per rank.

nodes.name: Still Air
nodes.desc: Moor Wind slows 5% per rank after.

nodes.name: Grave Stone
nodes.desc: A stone that fears the first foe that comes near.

nodes.name: The Dead Speak
nodes.desc: Barrow-call reaches every foe within 8 m.
